headline.title: Peter Sarlin’s QuTwo reaches $380M valuation in angel round
headline.summary: Finnish AI lab QyTw0, founded by Peter Sarlin, has achieved a valuation of approximately $380 million following a €25 million angel funding round. The investment highlights ongoing support for AI, quantum computing, and sovereign technology in Europe.

articles.title: (POSTER) From Sensors to Insight: Rapid, Edge-to-Core Application Development for Sensor-Driven Applications
articles.summary: The paper presents a pattern-based, AI-assisted methodology for the rapid development of sensor-driven applications, addressing the challenges of transforming raw sensor data into actionable insights across the edge-to-cloud continuum. Utilizing Pegasus workflows on the FABRIC testbed, the authors outline a five-step development process to streamline application creation.

articles.title: Google is partnering with XPRIZE and Range Media Partners on the $3.5 million Future Vision film competition.
articles.summary: Google has announced a partnership with XPRIZE and Range Media Partners to launch the $3.5 million Future Vision film competition. The initiative aims to encourage filmmakers to create innovative narratives that explore the potential of technology and its impact on society.

articles.title: SAP bets $1.16B on 18-month-old German AI lab and says yes to NemoClaw
articles.summary: SAP has announced its acquisition of German AI startup Prior Labs for $1.16 billion, signaling a significant investment in AI development. Additionally, the company will restrict customer access to certain AI agents, including Nvidia's NemoClaw.

articles.title: Altara secures $7M to bridge the data gap that’s slowing down physical sciences
articles.summary: Altara has raised $7 million to enhance its AI platform, which focuses on diagnosing failures and accelerating research and development in the physical sciences by integrating data from disparate sources. The funding will support efforts to address the challenges posed by siloed data in the industry.

articles.title: Apple agrees to pay iPhone owners $250 million for not delivering AI Siri
articles.summary: Apple has reached a $250 million settlement in a class action lawsuit alleging that it misled customers regarding the availability of its AI Siri features. The settlement applies to U.S. purchasers of iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16 models between June 10, 2024, and a specified date.

articles.title: Marc Lore says that AI will soon enable anyone open a restaurant
articles.summary: Marc Lore's company, Wonder, aims to revolutionize the restaurant industry by developing AI-powered "restaurant factories" that allow individuals to create virtual food brands simply by providing a prompt. This innovation is expected to democratize restaurant ownership and streamline the food service process.

articles.title: Apple plans to make iOS 27 a Choose Your Own Adventure of AI models
articles.summary: Apple's upcoming iOS 27 will allow users to select from various third-party AI models for different tasks, enhancing personalization and functionality. This feature aims to provide a more tailored user experience by integrating diverse AI options.

articles.title: 2026 Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Smart Manufacturing
articles.summary: The article outlines a roadmap for the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning in smart manufacturing by 2026, highlighting their potential to enhance efficiency and adaptability in industrial processes. It also addresses significant challenges such as managing complex industrial data and ensuring compatibility with diverse sensing and control systems.

articles.title: Accelerating battery research with an AI interface between FINALES and Kadi4Mat
articles.summary: Researchers have developed an AI interface that connects FINALES and Kadi4Mat to enhance the optimization of formation protocols for sodium-ion coin cells, aiming to improve their longevity and End Of Life (EOL) performance. The study focuses on balancing the reduction of formation time with the enhancement of performance outcomes, thereby minimizing resource consumption and accelerating battery research.

articles.title: Arithmetic in the Wild: Llama uses Base-10 Addition to Reason About Cyclic Concepts
articles.summary: A recent study on Llama-3.1-8B explores its reasoning capabilities regarding cyclic concepts, such as determining the month six months after August. The findings indicate that the model employs a generic addition mechanism rather than directly computing modular addition, despite the circular structure of its representations.

articles.title: Valley3: Scaling Omni Foundation Models for E-commerce
articles.summary: Valley3 is a new omni multimodal large language model designed for various global e-commerce tasks, integrating text, images, video, and audio for unified understanding and reasoning. Its notable feature is the native multilingual audio capability, enhanced to support critical audio-visual tasks, especially in short-video contexts.
